Muqanov (1974, printed p. 62/PDF p. 62) gives a 12-name flat Ergenekti Uaq roster, while the baseline 2015 source gives a different four-name flat roster. It does not make the ten non-overlapping names descendants of Bидәлі, Жансары, Баржақсы or Шайкөз. Do not union the two rosters at one level; the ten candidate edges are held pending a source that proves cross-version nesting.

tribes.decision: Added the reviewed subset; this is not a complete genealogy.

Academic and reference sources place Töre outside the zhuz clan structure as the hereditary Chinggisid estate. They document descent traditions (primarily through Jochi) but do not establish a bounded, inclusive branch roster suitable for this card. Individual dynastic chains are deliberately not converted into subtribes.

The checked scholarly source describes Қожа as a genealogical/social group with regional diversity and examines origin, settlement and status; the e-history source explicitly says their origins are not common. No accessible primary/academic source in this pass supplied a bounded parent-child roster that could safely be rendered as one clan tree. Do not turn religious lineages of individual saints into subtribes.

The 2019 peer-reviewed article calls Töleñgit a genealogical group, analyses origins, composition and resettlement, and cites Vostrov–Mukanov that Töre, Қожа and Töleñgit were outside traditional clan associations. It does not provide a verified internal parent-child hierarchy; no branch is proposed.
